question.text: In the Indian equity derivatives market, which type of options are currently traded?

answer.text: European options only, which can be exercised only on the expiry date
American options only, which can be exercised any time before or on expiry
Both European and American options depending on the underlying
Bermuda options which can be exercised on specific dates before expiry

explanation.text: The Logic: In the Indian equity derivatives markets, only European options are traded. A European option can be exercised only on the expiry date. A contract specified as CE is a Call European option and PE is a Put European option. American options (which can be exercised any time before or on the expiry date) are not available for trading on Indian exchanges at this time. The Trap: Students may assume both types are available since the workbook describes both European and American options conceptually. The presence of American options on some global exchanges may also create confusion. The terms CE and PE in the Indian market specifically denote European options.
